fact: Chad's government signed a five-year framework agreement with Moov Money, Airtel Money, Konoom and Cashi-Tchad under which the State can pay salaries, bonuses or pensions by mobile money, and every civil servant can be paid by bank or mobile wallet free of charge.
title: Tchad : L'État s'allie aux opérateurs Mobile money pour encaisser les impôts et payer les salaires
